parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHKH-type (complex 6-layer curve)
Aquifer depth: 24.4 m – 124 m (resistive sandy sequence, layers 4–5)
Recommendation: Case off the shallow clayey/sandy-clay interval (9.2–24.4 m) and screen the borehole across the thick resistive sand zone from about 24.4 m to 124 m; drill to a minimum total depth of ~130 m to fully penetrate this aquiferous sequence and confirm the underlying very high-resistivity unit (>124 m) as a non-productive base before terminating the hole.
